text.description_html:
Acorn AKBBR, 6-1/2" Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinge

The perfect shutter hardware can really elevate a home's curb appeal. If you want something that looks as if it could have been made in the old west but will stand the test of time, Acorn's Stainless Steel 6-1/2" Connecticut Style Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinges will do just that. They are made out of stainless steel--strap, pintle and fasteners--so you know that they will last. It has a matte black finish for a rustic look.

Features and Specifications of the 6-1/2" Connecticut Style Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinge:

  • Material: Stainless steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length: 6-1/2" (Measurements from center of pintles.)
  • Width: 1"
  • Pintle Diameter: 3/8"
  • Pintle Length: 4-7/8"
  • Packaged Includes: 4 strap hinges, 4 pintles, and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

Priced and sold as 2 pairs (4 hinges, one set for each shutter).
